rubrics.justification: The response overstates image quality and assigns classic 3AA features not clearly visible in the image; the blastocoel, ICM prominence, and cohesive TE are not well demonstrated, so several morphology details appear inferred from the provided grade rather than the image itself.

It integrates age, tubal factor, prior live birth/miscarriage, AMH, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness well with prognosis, though some claims (e.g., implied trilaminar lining, very high euploidy estimate) are somewhat overstated.

The reasoning is generally logical and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and favorable patient factors to a good prognosis, though confidence is somewhat inflated given the uncertain image-based morphology and speculative comments about ovarian response.

Recommendations such as single embryo transfer and not routinely requiring PGT-A at age 24 are broadly guideline-consistent, but suggesting aspirin/thrombophilia workup based on a single miscarriage is not strongly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future stimulation review, including SET and protocol reassessment, but some suggestions are generic and a few are speculative rather than tightly case-driven.
